prompt:
A real photograph, taken with a good phone camera and looking exactly like a phone photograph, of a quiet talk between a man, a woman and a chaplain in a small family room of a care home, in a wide horizontal picture, everything in sharp focus. Natural colours, soft afternoon daylight from the window. The textures of real cotton, wool, plastic, steel, skin and hair, with the true depth and the slight lens perspective of a photograph.

The first reference picture is a real phone photograph taken in the same care home: use it for the photographic look and for the warm, homely style of the house; this picture is set in a small family room of the house.

A MAN and A WOMAN of about fifty, brother and sister, sit side by side in two armchairs on the left of the picture: he in a navy-blue jumper, she in a dark-green cardigan, both sad and tired, the woman holding a paper tissue.

A CHAPLAIN, a woman of about sixty with short grey hair, in a dark-blue jacket over a light blouse, sits in an armchair opposite them on the right of the picture, leaning forward a little, listening, her hands open on her knees. Their eyes are on each other.

THE ROOM: a low wooden table between them with a teapot, three cups and a box of paper tissues, a lamp, a green plant, a window with light curtains.

The whole picture carries no writing, numbers, print, symbol or logo anywhere: the clothes have no name badge, no embroidery and no brand, every paper is blank or carries only grey lines and empty boxes, and every screen shows only plain pale-blue panels.
